name: hud_ui_triplet_interpolate_layout
description: HudUiTriplet::InterpolateLayout updates the active scoreboard layout fields by linearly interpolating their start/end pairs.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD triplet/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40e910 validates seven independent computations of start + ((end - start) * t), converted through _ftol, for baseX, baseY, rowPitchY, lapsColumnOffsetX, killsColumnOffsetX, fontSize, and fontWeight.
The native smoke verifies all seven fields with increasing, decreasing, negative, fractional, and beyond-end interpolation inputs, including truncation through the integer conversion path.
